history: The review ran {rounds} and fixed {fixes} itself. The vet: {vet}
tracesBoard: Every statement in the spec traces to your board, your framing, your rulings, your answers, or craft recorded for your veto.
tracesNoBoard: Every statement in the spec traces to your framing, your rulings, your answers, or craft recorded for your veto.
boardSaved: The approved board is saved with the spec.
boardNotSaved: The approved board is not saved with the spec.
next: Once you've chosen Approve and said in the chat that you're done, the advisor adds the breakdown to the same PR (or, where the project keeps specs outside the repo or gitignored, beside the spec where it is kept) and vets it, and an independent read of the breakdown still runs where it applies. Then one merge word from you covers both, and the issues are filed as it merges. If another answer here changes the spec, the spec goes back through its checks, a new vet and a new approval first.
doneStep: Once every answer shows it is saved, go back to the chat and say you're done. The session then reads your answers and your verdict together.
doneStepInChat: Answer each item and the approval here in the chat, then say you're done. The session reads your answers and your verdict together.

leftoverOptions.label: Fix in a follow-up
leftoverOptions.consequence: Ships now; a follow-up issue is filed with a revisit date.

leftoverOptions.label: Fix before merge
leftoverOptions.consequence: The PR goes back for the fix and returns with a new sheet.

pr.closureQuestion: Close the spec {spec} with this merge
pr.closureIfLeft: The spec stays open after this PR merges.
pr.nothingToAccept: Nothing. The review left nothing for you.
pr.acceptingUnchecked: This sheet was not checked against the PR body's What we're accepting. Read that section on the PR before you merge.
pr.acceptingUncheckedCount: Not checked against the PR body
pr.acceptingCanon: Checked against the PR body's What we're accepting: every acceptance it lists is covered by a Canon ruling ({ids}).
pr.acceptingCanonCount: Checked: all covered by Canon rulings
pr.historyCap: The loop stopped at its round cap.
pr.historyNoGoAhead: No owner's word or standing ruling lets the PR go ahead without it.
pr.historyNotIndependent: {name} is from a maker's model family, so its review was not independent.
pr.historyLaterRounds: Earlier rounds read {earlier}; later rounds re-checked the fixes on the reviewed final commit {final}.
pr.historyNoFinalReview: No planned reviewer's run covers the final commit {final}. The reviews ran on {earlier}, so what changed after that was not reviewed.
pr.historyLeftover: 1 finding is left for you below.
pr.historyLeftovers: {count} findings are left for you below.
pr.specPin: The breakdown vet pins 1 file, and it still hashes to its pinned value.
pr.specPins: The breakdown vet pins {count} files, and each one still hashes to its pinned value.
pr.breakdownTitleOne: This merge files the breakdown: 1 body the filing writes
pr.breakdownTitle: This merge files the breakdown: {count} bodies the filing writes
pr.changed: The PR moved past commit {previous} since the last sheet was made. Your answers to unchanged items are kept; the merge verdict starts over on this sheet.
pr.carried: On {date} the PR moved past commit {previous}: {moved}. That is not a material change, because {why}. Your answers and your merge verdict carry forward to this sheet.
pr.advisorWalked: The advisor walked this first, except where a stop says otherwise; the pictures come from {from}.
pr.notWalkedByAdvisor: The advisor didn't walk this stop: {reason}
pr.tapPicture: Tap a picture to see it full size.

walkFixes.label: Fix before merge
walkFixes.consequence: This goes back with your note and returns with a new sheet.

walkFixes.label: Fix in a follow-up
walkFixes.consequence: This can still merge; a follow-up is filed with your note.

pr.screenshotUnavailable: Screenshots can't be added here; say what you saw in the note.
pr.walkSchemaMissing: The walk is off: the sheet's schema has no answer list in $defs.walkAnswersByKind for a stop on this sheet. Republish the schema, then reload.
pr.walkProblemsOne: 1 walk problem needs a choice: fix before merge, or in a follow-up.
pr.walkProblemsMany: {count} walk problems need a choice: fix before merge, or in a follow-up.
pr.followUpsOne: 1 walk problem goes to a follow-up.
pr.followUpsMany: {count} walk problems go to a follow-up.
pr.notWalkedOne: 1 walk stop not walked yet. That doesn't lock the merge.
pr.notWalkedMany: {count} walk stops not walked yet. That doesn't lock the merge.
pr.craftHeading: Decided as craft, for your veto
pr.decidedForYouIntro: The advisor judged these craft, not yours, so they are not cards. Make one yours and it comes back to you as a card.
pr.mineLockedOne: You made 1 decided item yours. It comes back to you as a card first, so Merge waits.
pr.mineLockedMany: You made {count} decided items yours. They come back to you as cards first, so Merge waits.
pr.decidedInChat: To take one back, say its label and "mine" (for example "D1 mine").
pr.verdictCaption: Saved as you tap. Your merge word is this verdict plus "done" in the chat.
pr.verdictInChat: Answer {choices} here in the chat, then say you're done. {merge} counts only once every item above is accepted; an answer that sends the PR back is not accepted.
pr.unlocks: Unlocks when every item above is accepted: {accepted} of {total} so far.
pr.resaveLegacy: Merge stays locked: an earlier version of this page saved the answers on these cards: {titles}. Clear each one and pick it again to save it afresh.
pr.resaveNoRevision: Merge stays locked: this browser can't mark the saved answers on these cards the way Merge needs: {titles}. Answer them from a browser that can.
pr.sendBack: You chose to fix something before merge, so this goes back for that fix. It returns with a new sheet; nothing to answer here.

index.title: Waiting on you
index.nothingBlocking: Nothing is blocking work right now.
index.firstAnswerCounts: Answer here or in the chat; whichever comes first counts. When the chat and the index disagree, the advisor asks.
index.acceptingUnchecked: Not checked against the PR body
index.acceptingCanon: Checked: all covered by Canon rulings
index.beingFixed: Going back for a fix · a new sheet comes after it
index.done: When every sheet you meant to answer is saved, say "done" in the chat.
